Container.Name: Marquee
Container.Overview: Marquee: a self-hosted media server for movies, TV, anime, music and live TV, with apps for the web, iPhone, iPad, Apple TV, Android and Android TV. Hardware transcoding with NVIDIA (keep --runtime=nvidia in Extra Parameters; needs the Nvidia Driver plugin) or Intel Quick Sync (add the /dev/dri device). Install "Marquee Soundprint" too for music analysis, radios, Muse and natural-language search. Open the WebUI to create the admin account and add your libraries; enter a free TMDB API key under Settings → Metadata.
Container.Requires: Host networking lets the apps find the server on your network. For NVIDIA transcoding install the Nvidia Driver plugin; without an NVIDIA GPU remove --runtime=nvidia from Extra Parameters. The transcode scratch space is held in RAM (8 GB here; change size= in Extra Parameters).

Config.Name: WebUI port
Config.Description: Marquee's web app and API (host networking: this is the port it listens on).

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Database, settings, artwork cache, backups and logs.

Config.Name: Video
Config.Description: Your movies, shows, anime and home videos (one subfolder each). Read-only is safest; set to read/write to let Library Health move unwanted duplicates to a recoverable trash folder.

Config.Name: Plex data (optional)
Config.Description: A Plex Media Server data folder to import watch history, ratings and playlists from (read-only). Leave empty if you don't use Plex.

Config.Name: Intel Quick Sync
Config.Description: Add /dev/dri for Intel Quick Sync transcoding (also add --group-add with the render group id to Extra Parameters: stat -c %g /dev/dri/renderD128).

Config.Name: NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES
Config.Description: Which NVIDIA GPUs Marquee may use.
